about: The smoke of the cigarette the player smokes on the balcony on launch day, as the game 2099 draws it (CigaretteView): a thin wisp rising off the lit end all the time it burns, and the breath of a drag let out ahead of the face, slowing, spreading, rising and thinning away. Both are let go into the world rather than carried with the head. The cigarette hangs off the player's camera, so both are hung here off the scene record's balcony camera; the cigarette itself, the player's own, is not on the stage. Real footage checked: exhaled cigarette smoke leaves the lips as a dense stream that slows within a few tens of centimetres and billows, and a resting cigarette's smoke rises as one thin laminar thread that breaks into curls (the owner's rule: start from footage, many fine cards tied to the world).
